Cape Town's Most Funomenal Clown

Magic, Laughter & Legacy

One of Cape Town's most decorated clown and entertainer!

Expect big laughs, silly surprises, a little magic, and the occasional flying balloon animal. Mungo turns every party into a show the kids won't stop talking about.

The Variety Comedy Show—Main Course.
Balloon Chaos—Dessert.

Mungo the Clown offers a Variety Clown Magic Show for Birthdays, Events, and all Happy Occasions. His action-packed, laughter-filled, interactive show includes Clowning, Juggling, Magic tricks, Chinese Yo-Yo, Balloon Comedy, and a wide variety of 50 different animal balloon designs. His skilled, funny, action-packed show offers great value for money and will be enjoyed by children and grown-ups of all ages. He knows exactly how to make your child feel honoured and special, and will make this a magical and lasting memory.

How the Show Works

The Main Show 50 mins

A full variety comedy experience—clowning, magic, juggling, Chinese Yo-Yo, and balloon comedy. No early balloons, no distractions. Just pure entertainment for the whole family.

The Birthday Moment

Right after the balloon comedy segment, the Birthday Child takes centre stage to be honoured—the climax of the show. Mungo twists their chosen balloon animal live, making them the star of the moment as everyone cheers.

Refreshment Break 10 mins

Time for drinks, toilet trips, and catching breath before the finale.

🎈

Balloon Modelling for Everyone 30–40 mins

Every child receives their own custom balloon creation to take home and play with. Fun first. Chaos second.

Optional Extras Extend the Party

Want to keep going? Add on Face Painting, Piñata, or Party Games—perfect for stretching the celebration even further.

Quick Specs

Item Duration / Details
Show (incl. Birthday moment) 50 mins
Break 10 mins
Balloon modelling 30–40 mins
Optional Extras Face Painting • Piñata • Party Games
Total Approx. 1.5–1.75 hrs + extras
